summary: Iteration 10 REKAP GAJI (payroll) tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (settings GET/POST + 403 for kasir, report with role-based access, save override persistence, base salary reuse next month, reset override, kasir forbidden on save/reset). Frontend: admin sidebar shows 'Rekap Gaji', table renders all expected data-testids (payroll-table, month-filter, potongan-input/save, per-row gaji/komisi/potongan/total/save/reset/print, grand-total). Live total updates correctly (2000000+100000-50000 => Rp 2.050.000). Save triggers success toast and 'diedit' badge. Reset toast 'Direset ke perhitungan otomatis' fires. PDF download works: Slip_Gaji_Pemilik_Toko_Oktober_2026.pdf, no JS errors. Kasir: no 'Rekap Gaji' nav; /rekap-gaji redirects to / (adminOnly guard works).

issues: DB contains duplicate-name test users (two 'Pemilik Toko', two 'Kasir Toko'); note this is pre-existing test pollution acknowledged by main agent, not a bug. Commission is keyed by user_name which could cause misattribution if duplicates had sales.

critical_code_review_comments: payroll_report groups commission by user_name (not user_id). With duplicate names this will double-attribute laba_kotor. Consider keying by user_id (requires storing user_id on ecommerce_sales).
server.py is >1200 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, products, sales, payroll, attendance) for maintainability.
